misc.discord_discovery_description:
C.A.I.N. pen bot Discord thi kae khai kan fang ling sochel midia
doi chai borikan onlai (chen [FxTwitter](https://github.com/FixTweet/FxTwitter))

**doi sarup bot ni cha phot ling sochel midia mai doi attanomat nai woechan 'kae khai laeo'
saeng mi kan fang thi di kwa (chen tham hai len widio nai Discord dai doi trong)**

## khunnasombat lae chut den

- rong rap Twitter, Nitter, Instagram, TikTok, Reddit, Threads, Bluesky, Snapchat, Facebook,
  Pixiv, Twitch, Spotify, DeviantArt, Newgrounds, Mastodon, Tumblr, BiliBili, Pinterest, IFunny, YouTube, Imgur,
  Weibo, Fur Affinity, Rule34.xxx, Danbooru, Gelbooru, e621, e926, Realbooru, Hypnohub, Konachan, Yande.re,
  Derpibooru, Rule34.paheal, XBooru, TBIB lae wepsai kamnot eng thi khun lueak
- kan plae phot
- pit kan chai ngan tam wepsai, chong, samachik, botbat rue kham samkhan
- prap taeng phruetikam lae ruplak dai sung
- rong rap lai phasa
- intheo-fet than samai samrap kan tang kha
- samat top sanong to bot lae wephuk dai
- rong rap rupbaep makdao
- khaorop khwam pen suan tua
- mi sot khot hai truat sop

## withi chai ngan

phiang song kho khwam thi mi ling sochel midia thi rong rap chak nan bot cha lop kan fang dangdoem(tha mi) lae
phot mai pen ling thi 'kae khai laeo' doi attanomat

khun samat hai bot phoek choei ling dai doi kan phoem "fxignore" long nai kho khwam khong khun: kan fang pakati cha thuk kep wai tam doem

khun samat chatkan kan tang kha bot dai duai kham sang `/settings`

sut thai ni khun samat chai kham sang `/about` dai talot wela phuea rap khomun phoemtoem kiao kap bot lae rap khwam chuai luea
